annotations.title: Japan 防災庁 emergency request (2026-11-02): how much water, food and portable-toilet stock does this household need, is the home old quake standard, and what's left to do?

description: Turns the five-point emergency request (事前防災徹底のための緊急要請) issued by Japan's Disaster Management Agency (防災庁) on 2026-11-02 into a household checklist, rules as of 2026-11-02, from the request text, the PM's Office 災害への備え page, 防災庁 / METI portable-toilet guidance, MLIT seismic pages and the MoE pet pamphlet. Stockpile for days (default 7; the request: at least 3, ideally 1 week): drinking water 3 L per person per day (incl. cooking), 3 meals and 5 portable-toilet uses per person per day (infants: water only, milk and diapers listed), gap against haveWaterLiters / haveMeals / haveToiletUses; pets: food and water at least 5 days, ideally 7+. Building: 建築確認 before 1981-06-01 = old quake standard (旧耐震) → 耐震診断; build year 1981 → check the permit date; wooden houses 1981-06-01 – 2000-05-31 → MLIT 新耐震木造住宅検証法 owner self-check; renters → ask the landlord. builtYear accepts 1979, 昭和54, S54, 平成12, H12. Returns verdict (well_prepared | partly_prepared | not_prepared), summary, doneCount, household, days, stockpile {water {target, minimum3Days, have, gap, bottles2L}, meals, toiletUses, pets, alsoStock, rollingStock}, building {era old_standard | likely_old | new_pre2000_wood | new_standard | unknown, label, action}, request [{n, title, ja, status done | partial | todo, todo[]} ×5: 耐震・家具固定, 備蓄, ハザードマップ・避難経路, 非常持ち出し品, 防災訓練], links, note, sources, disclaimer. Use for '防災庁 緊急要請 何をすれば', '備蓄 何リットル 家族', '携帯トイレ 何回分', 'how much water to store Japan earthquake', 'is my house 旧耐震', 'Japan disaster preparedness checklist'. Not a disaster prediction (the request is a standing call to prepare). Educational, not official and not engineering or safety advice; not affiliated with 防災庁 or any government body.

buildingType.description: wood (木造 house) | non_wood (RC / steel, most マンション) | unknown (default).

builtYear.description: Year the home was built: 1979, 昭和54, S54, 平成12, H12.

days.description: Days to stock for (default 7; minimum 3 per the request).

evacuationRouteChecked.description: Knows the evacuation site and route.

furnitureFixed.description: Tall furniture and appliances are fixed.

goBagReady.description: Grab bag (非常持ち出し品) packed.

haveMeals.description: Meals of stored food already on hand.

haveToiletUses.description: Portable / emergency toilet uses (bags) already on hand.

hazardMapChecked.description: Checked hazard maps for home and work.

infants.description: Babies on milk / in diapers (water only; milk and diapers listed).

permitDate.description: 建築確認 date on the 確認済証, YYYY-MM-DD (exact 1981-06-01 line).

seismicDone.description: Already had a passing 耐震診断 or a retrofit.
